Prod_ImportHelp: Download the template and fill it in: category, supplier and unit are dropdowns, and the Custom Prices sheet takes one row per extra price (a product can have several). A row whose barcode already exists updates that product (blank cells are left unchanged); any other row adds a new product. A product listed on the Custom Prices sheet gets exactly those prices; one that isn't keeps its own.
